incident: labelling CLIs ran with the repo root as cwd; codex read-only sandbox and cursor ask mode can still read the dump holding the reference labels

incident: pgrep after setsid nohup recorded the launcher's PID; the kill -0 waiter fired at once (false 'driver died')

lesson: detached drivers should write their own PID file (os.getpid()) instead of being found with pgrep

incident: pilot cost extrapolation overestimated: Codex ~720 tokens/label in the pilot vs ~370 in the full pass; 5h pool 2.3 vs 1.5 pts per 100 labels
fix: per-chunk quota gates (pause on codex-5h floor, stop on 7d/auto floors) instead of trusting the estimate
lesson: quota gauges are whole-percent and small pilots are noisy; gate long runs per chunk and log quota per chunk to measure the real cost

incident: target repo had mixed CRLF/LF/mixed line endings; delegate apply failed with git apply and with --3way
fix: checked main-tree files equal base, copied changed files from the worktree; repo then normalised with .gitattributes (* text=auto eol=lf, *.ipynb -text) + git add --renormalize as its own commit
lesson: launch should warn on CRLF/mixed bases; apply could fall back to file copy when every touched file still equals its base blob

incident: delegate cost --repo showed 1 of 5 runs: copy-merged, read-only and review runs never reach runs.jsonl
fix: none yet; usage collected by hand from meta.json and review-1/meta.json

incident: brief's acceptance criterion (morph pairings preserve sum of amp^2) was physically wrong at the onset: duplicated partials start phase-coherent; Codex implemented it literally and the cross-vendor review approved it as spec-compliant
fix: orchestrator caught it on its own read; test marked provisional and the criterion turned into a user decision in the plan
lesson: review checks patch vs brief and cannot catch brief errors; for domain criteria add a review focus that challenges the brief's acceptance criteria, or ask the user first

incident: audit wrote 11 notebook copies to .audit/ inside the worktree; exit packet reported 1016 files / +18.3M lines

incident: brief asked for a byte-identical re-derive; Codex changed derive to keep the source revision's dump_date (every stage stamps the output id), and the cross-review approved it as spec-compliant
fix: orchestrator read the pipeline diff, reverted via followup round (dump_date = output id; tests compare modulo dump_date)

incident: auto-mode classifier denied `git rm` of tracked dump files and then the follow-up commit; work sat uncommitted until the user approved
fix: handoff written with the drafted commit message; user approved commit + rm + push/PR in one reply
lesson: in auto mode, bundle destructive/outward git steps (rm of tracked data, commit, push, PR, merge, tag) into one explicit approval request at the end of a work item

incident: none (positive): computing candidate-policy metrics (consensus/union/single-model F1 vs Wikidata, coverage) before asking let the user decide 4 design questions in one AskUserQuestion

incident: session sprawl: user added 3 items after the handoff item; context 36k -> 243k, cache read 14.0M (2.2x a single-item session)
fix: handoff kept current after each item, but /clear never offered
lesson: at an item boundary above ~120k context, write the handoff and offer /clear in one line before starting the next item

incident: delegable work done inline: 5-file doc refresh and a near-copy fetcher script spent Claude quota (51% left, pace 1.5x) while cursor-auto sat at 71% (pace 2.8x)
fix: none this session

incident: none (positive): a 1-request spot check (12 pages, prop=images) falsified the 'no rights category = no files' hypothesis before it entered the plan, and exposed the PMLUS/PMLASIA server tokens
fix: n/a

incident: stale delegate worktree (viewer-layout-style) with uncommitted edits survived a day after its run was applied as 874c53d
fix: diffed its files against the merged commit, then git worktree remove --force
lesson: runs.py status should flag applied runs whose worktree still exists; apply should end by suggesting cleanup

incident: git stash/pop to compare pre-change behaviour unstaged 11 git mv renames; a sed edit on a wrapped Markdown line matched nothing silently
fix: git add -A to restage; python replace with assert count==1
lesson: use git show HEAD:path > tmp for before/after checks; never sed prose without verifying a match

incident: full pipeline derive re-applied stale local caches (2026-09-24, older than the r014 crawl): 12 composer cells changed outside the item's columns; a single-stage replay also inherited r015 meta with an absolute ledger path
fix: diff_dumps review caught the drift before commit; rebuilt r016 as a single-stage replay, normalised the inherited path
lesson: read the dump diff's changed-cell list before shipping a derive; cells outside the item's columns mean cache drift, not the change under review

incident: user said 'ok go on' after a finished item at 205k context; the orchestrator started the next item instead of offering a handoff + /clear (third session in a row)
fix: context guard fired at ~256k during the PR item; handoff written after merge
lesson: at an item boundary above ~120k, reply with the handoff and a one-line /clear offer before starting; 'go on' is not a reason to skip it

incident: build item finished at 146k; interactive annotation Q&A, repo integration and redump planning continued in place to 274k (fourth session in a row)
fix: context guard fired at ~270k on the log-dump request; handoff already current
lesson: when a build turns into interactive support, write a support-mode handoff (tool URL, store layout, decided cases, blindness rules) and offer /clear before answering the next question

incident: gh pr merge blocked by auto-mode classifier (Merge Without Review) although the handoff listed the merge; next read-only command also blocked
fix: told the user, continued with S1; user approved one message later
lesson: a handoff step to merge is not approval: check CI, ask in one line, keep working (memory merge-needs-explicit-ok)

incident: new rule (list year refines a coarse Wikidata death) passed all gates but flipped 2 composers to PD; article leads say 'after 1912/1914' (floruits), GND gives †1962
fix: rule restricted to birth years; r017 rebuilt with 0 PD flips before the PR
lesson: check every PD flip in diff_dumps against a source before opening the PR; gates do not catch plausible-but-wrong values
